title: Undergarden Imprints
description: Soft Imprints addon for The Undergarden compatibility
body:
## **About:**
Resource pack that adds custom imprint profiles for [Soft Imprints](https://modrinth.com/mod/snow-imprints)


![Image #1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a45b2bf81c750509ca14a100d3bba5640c0782c7.webp)

## **Requirements:**
- [Soft Imprints](https://modrinth.com/mod/snow-imprints)
- [The Undergarden](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-undergarden)


## **How to install:**
- Download the .zip file
- Drop it into your resourcepacks folder
- Enable it in Options → Resource Packs
- Press F3+T
